== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Inquisitors, also known as the Inquisitors of [[Ach'magut|Ach’magut]] or [[Ach'magut]]'s Inquisitors, are the spider-like spawn of the [[Great Elder]] known as [[Ach'magut|Ach’magut]], the [[Overseer]]. These ten-legged creatures possess purplish skin that can shift shades to blend into shadows, and they are characterized by numerous eyes located on flexible stalks. Physically, they feature exoskeletons and multiple limbs, making them formidable combatants capable of surviving even after losing their heads. Functioning as the minions and assassins of [[Ach'magut|Ach’magut]], the Inquisitors serve his eternal [[hunger]] for knowledge by traveling across [[The Empire|the Empire]] to gather and deconstruct information. They are known for their coordinated, intelligent behavior, often acting with precise timing under the direct orders of their master. While they frequently prefer to observe and watch from a distance, they are capable of extreme violence and calculated cruelty. Their actions include depopulating cities, abducting vulnerable individuals for rituals intended to invoke the void, and manipulating environments—such as altering architecture or trapping people in burning rooms—to observe human reactions to crises. They have been sighted throughout [[The Empire|the Empire]], including in [[Dylia]], [[Vandenyas]], the Nire, and the Capital.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Inquisitors are spider-like beings associated with [[Ach'magut|Ach’magut]]. Typically acting as observers, these entities possess multiple eyes that cover every angle of their surroundings. During the events in southern [[Izyria]], they were cornered within a hive.}}
